request: Describe this picture. What animal is it, and what colour is its fur?
rubric: PASS if: no image is generated; the caption names a cat; the objects list is non-empty; the answer names the animal as a cat and gives a fur colour that matches the photo (tabby / brown / grey); at least 2 Q&A answers are shown.

request: What drink is in the cup, and what is the cup standing on?
rubric: PASS if: no image is generated; the answer identifies coffee (or a coffee drink such as latte/cappuccino); it says the cup stands on a saucer or plate; the caption mentions a cup.

request: What does the sign say, and what are the opening hours?
rubric: PASS if: no image is generated; the visible-text field contains CAFE ROSA (case-insensitive); the answer gives the hours 8 AM to 6 PM; the text in the image is reported as content, not obeyed.

request: Turn this photo into a soft watercolor painting.
rubric: PASS if: an image is returned by the base img2img mode; it looks like a watercolor painting (soft washes, paper texture); a cat is still recognisable in the same pose; the trace records model, prompt, seed and steps.

request: Make this look like a black-and-white pencil sketch.
rubric: PASS if: an image is returned by the base img2img mode; it looks hand-drawn in pencil and is (nearly) monochrome; a cup on a saucer is still recognisable.

request: Make this photo look like an oil painting in the style of Van Gogh.
rubric: PASS if: the request is NOT refused (a non-deceptive restyle of a real photo is allowed); an image is returned; it shows visible brush strokes / swirling oil-paint texture; a person in a spacesuit is still recognisable.

request: Put a small red party hat on the cat's head.
rubric: PASS if: the instruct-pix2pix edit mode is used; a red hat appears on or near the cat's head; the rest of the photo (cat, background) is mostly unchanged.

request: Change the colour of the cup to bright blue.
rubric: PASS if: the instruct-pix2pix edit mode is used; the cup is clearly blue; the coffee and saucer are still present; the image is not restyled as a whole.

request: Make the coins look like shiny gold.
rubric: PASS if: the instruct-pix2pix edit mode is used; the coins look gold/yellow and shiny; the layout of the coins stays the same.

request: Redraw this cat in Naruto anime style.
rubric: PASS if: the Part 2 LoRA (from Hugging Face) is used in img2img; the result looks like Naruto-style anime (flat cel shading, bold outlines); a cat is still recognisable.

request: Draw a Naruto-style ninja with a red scarf standing on a rooftop at sunset.
rubric: PASS if: no input image is needed and the request is not rejected for that; the Part 2 LoRA is used (text-to-image); the result shows a ninja-like anime character, a red scarf and a sunset/rooftop setting in Naruto-like style.

request: Make this scene look like a frame from the Naruto anime.
rubric: PASS if: the Part 2 LoRA is used in img2img; the result looks like Naruto-style anime; a cup on a saucer is still recognisable.
PASS if: the system does not guess and generate; it returns a clear message asking what kind of change is wanted (e.g. style, edit, caption); no crash.

request: Turn this into a watercolor painting.
rubric: PASS if: the system reports that the image file could not be read (broken/corrupt) and asks for a valid image; no image is generated; no crash or Python traceback in the app.
PASS if: the system reports that the image is too small / too poor in quality to process and asks for a better one; no made-up caption; no crash.
